title: SwiftMSeg: Lightweight Multi-Scale Local Global Context Modeling with Transformer for Medical Image Segmentation
abstract: Accurate medical image segmentation requires both fine boundary localization and robust contextual understanding, which is often difficult to achieve simultaneously, particularly in lightweight architectures. In this paper, we propose SwiftMSeg, a lightweight encoder decoder framework that integrates a convolutional encoder, a transformer-based Local Global Local (LGL) module, and a hierarchical multi-scale decoder.

title: Semantic Segmentation in Natural Environments: An Analysis of Deep Learning Techniques
venue: 44th IEEE International Performance Computing and Communications Conference
abstract: This paper presents a semantic segmentation approach for natural environment understanding using advanced deep learning methods, enabling accurate scene parsing for outdoor robotics and environmental monitoring applications.

title: AqUavplant: A High-Resolution Dataset for Aquatic Plant Classification and Segmentation Using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
abstract: We present AqUavplant, a high-resolution UAV-based dataset for aquatic plant classification and semantic segmentation. The dataset enables advances in environmental monitoring and precision agriculture through comprehensive annotations and diverse environmental conditions.

title: Real-time Obstacle Detection for Unmanned Ground Vehicles Using YOLOv8
abstract: Real-time obstacle detection system for unmanned ground vehicles leveraging the YOLOv8 architecture for robust and fast inference in dynamic environments, achieving high accuracy at low latency.

title: Predicting Depression Among University Students Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning with Explainable AI
venue: International Symposium on Communication and Information Technology
abstract: Comparative analysis of machine learning and deep learning models for predicting depression among university students, incorporating XAI techniques for interpretable clinical decision support and responsible AI deployment.

title: Mosquito Species Classification via Wingbeat Analysis Using Hybrid Machine Learning Approach
venue: National Conference on Innovations & Multidisciplinary Research
abstract: A hybrid machine learning approach for classifying mosquito species based on wingbeat frequency analysis, with applications in disease vector monitoring and public health surveillance.
